THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE G BASAVARAJA  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed petition under Section 482 of BNSS 2023, for grant of anticipatory bail in the event of their arrest in Crime No.17/2026 of Yadrami Police Station.

2. On the basis of the complaint filed by Mallinatha son of Shivalingappa Kunhally, Yadrami Police have registered the case in Crime No.17/2026 against the accused Nos.1 to 4 for the commission of offences under Section 409 and 420 IPC.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:2019 HC-KAR 3.
The petitioners, who are accused Nos.2 to 4, have filed an application under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, for grant of anticipatory bail.
The same came to be rejected by the III Additional District and Sessions Judge, Kalaburagi, in Crl.Misc.No.175/2026 dated 18.02.2026.

entities.text: III Additional District and Sessions Judge, Kalaburagi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that there is an inordinate delay of nearly 3 years in lodging the complaint and the delay is not satisfactorily explained.
Petitioner No.1 had given Rs.1,50,000/- to accused No.1 for the purpose of sanctioning a house in Muraganoor Village, Taluk Yadrami, District Kalaburagi.
When accused No.1 came to Muraganoor Village, he showed some papers with government seals to the villagers and said that through GPS he was surveying the place for allotment of houses.
At that juncture, the villagers assembled and enquired with accused No.1.
Accused No.1 said that he would be getting the houses and goat sheds sanctioned from the government if they paid him money like petitioner No.1.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:2019 HC-KAR
Hence, the villagers, believing accused No.1, gave money and thereby they were cheated by accused No.1.
The petitioners are also victims in this case, as it is accused No.1 who has duped the petitioners along with the villagers by cheating in the name of providing government facilities.
Petitioner No.1 is the daughter of petitioners No.2 and 3, and all the petitioners are not at all concerned with the alleged complicity of the offence in any manner.

The Ambika vs The State Of Karnataka on 3 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32611400/
2 allegation of cheating and breach of trust is against accused No.1, as he is the person who has collected Rs.17,80,000/- from the villagers and thereby has cheated them.

sentences.text: The petitioners have not played any role in the alleged incident.
Further, the counsel submitted that the petitioners are not required for custodial interrogation.
On all these grounds, he seek that this petition be allowed.
4. I have examined the materials placed before this Court.

A plain reading of the complaint reveals that accused Nos.1 to 4 have collected money from 22 persons of Muraganoor Village in an extent of Rs.17,80,000/-, NC: 2026:KHC-K:2019 HC-KAR assuring them of getting benefits from the government for houses, cow sheds, goat sheds, etc., and thereafter the accused have neither provided any facilities from the government, nor have returned the amount.
5.
This FIR was registered on 04.02.2026.
The accused are absconding.
6. It is submitted that the present petitioners are also victims.
They have paid an amount of more than Rs.1,00,000/- each to accused No.1.
In this regard, the petitioners have not placed any materials to show that they are also victims.
If really they are victims, they ought to have filed a complaint against accused No.1.
Till this day, they have not lodged any complaint against accused No.1.
Hence, the argument advanced on behalf of the petitioners at this stage cannot be accepted.
7. Be that as it may, considering the nature and gravity of the offence and the facts and circumstances of this case, the accused are required for custodial NC: 2026:KHC-K:2019 HC-KAR interrogation.
Hence, at this stage, I do not find any grounds to grant anticipatory bail.

Accordingly,
I proceed to pass the following order:
ORDER i.
The petition is dismissed.

Sd/-
